text:
Iris (PartnerOps): Heads-up — vendor notified us they're changing how they surface entitlements in the marketplace feed next Monday. New feed will send nested `lines[]` per invoice with optional `claim_guid`. We rely on a top-level `claim_id`. Potential for silent drops. Anyone free to triage?
Ben (Integrations): Do they guarantee `claim_guid` for every line? If optional we must fallback. Can you share sample?
Iris (PartnerOps): Pasted sample in #secure: `{'invoice_id':'inv-9','lines':[{'claim_guid':'cg-1','entitlement':'ent-A','units':200},{'claim_guid':null,'entitlement':'ent-B','units':150}]}`
Yuki (Analytics): If claim_guid null, we should synthesize a deterministic fingerprint (entitlement + customer + hour + units) and mark it as `synth_claim`. That lets us upsert instead of blind insert.
Claire (Billing): Important: if synthesized ids differ from vendor later, we need mapping to avoid double-billing. Can we store vendor_line_hash and vendor_line_ref in ledger?
Ben (Integrations): Plan: implement parser that emits `claim_id` = claim_guid or fingerprint, and write `vendor_claim_ref` and `synth=true/false`. Deploy behind `marketplace_lines_v2` flag. Add metric `marketplace.lines.synth_count`.
marketplace-bot: delivery-warning: 12% of sample lines missing claim_guid in vendor canary.
Yuki (Analytics): I'll create hourly delta job comparing legacy ingestion vs lines_v2 mapping: fields -> customer_id, hour, legacy_count, v2_count, synth_count, delta_pct. Finance wants this visible during shadow window.
Claire (Billing): Thresholds: if delta_pct > 0.5% or synth_count > 1000 units for a customer-hour, hold auto-bill and flag for manual review. Also require vendor mapping backfill if mismatch > 1%.
Iris (PartnerOps): Action items: @Ben implement parser + tests + feature flag; @Yuki build delta job and dashboard; @Claire confirm credit policy and manual review flow; I'll ask vendor to delay wide rollout until our shadow run completes. Target: staging tests by EOD, 24h shadow on prod tomorrow.
Ben (Integrations): I'll open a small PR and add the metric. Will also include migration script to compute last 72h deltas.
Iris (PartnerOps): Thanks — will post PR link and vendor confirmation here.
